name: Sedating Scrib

abilities.name: Slam
abilities.description: The scrib throws itself at you, dealing low physical damage.

abilities.name: Spit
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack dealing minor poison damage.

abilities.name: Narcotic Spray
abilities.description: The scrib spits a sedative poison at a target which causes them to fall over and convulse for a moment. This makes the target unable to move and perform any action, including breaking-free.

abilities.name: Cave In
abilities.description: While the Transmuted Hive Lord performs its "Cave In" attack the Sedating Scrib burrows underground out of reach for the duration of the attack.

related_quests: What Was Lost: Help Shatasha investigate Dwemer ruins.
Pledge: Darkshade II: Explore Darkshade Caverns II and return Undaunted.
summary: The Sedating Scrib is a kwama scrib that accompanies and supports the Transmuted Hive Lord in Darkshade Caverns II.
